answer: Reaching the ferrous of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work. A orchard of per-task receipts records who did what, and the oasis of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
